name: Sei Shōnagon
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 62); Porter’s note gives the dates as: retired 1000.

poems.title: Too long to-night you’ve lingered here
poems.author: Sei Shōnagon
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 62
poems.text:
Too long to-night you’ve lingered here,
And, though you imitate
The crowing of a cock, ’twill not
Unlock the tollbar gate;
Till daylight must you wait.
